title: Statistics for Data Science I
standfirst: Descriptive statistics, probability, distributions and the first principles of statistical reasoning.

description_paragraphs: Students will be introduced to large datasets and the insights that can be derived from them. The course shall also cover fundamental concepts of probability leading to a discussion on random variables.
faculty: Prof. Usha Mohan, Department of Management Studies, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Introduction to data types; Descriptive and inferential statistics; Scales of measurement.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Categorical data - description, frequency distributions, best practices for graphing; Mode and median.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Numerical data - frequency tables; Measures of central tendency - Mean, median and mode; Quartiles and percentiles; Measures of dispersion - range, variance, standard deviation and IQR; Five-number summary.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Association between variables - categorical (contingency tables, relative frequencies) numerical (scatterplot, covariance, Pearson correlation, point-biserial correlation).

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Basic principles of counting and factorial concepts - addition and multiplication rules; Factorials.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Conditional probability - multiplication rule, independence, law of total probability, Bayes' theorem.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Random Variables - random experiment, sample space, discrete and continuous random variable; Probability mass function; Cumulative distribution function.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Expectation and variance - expectation, variance, and standard deviation of discrete random variables.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Discrete Distributions - Bernoulli trials (i.i.d), binomial (expectation and variance), Poisson, geometric, and negative binomial distributions.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Continuous random variables - area under the curve; Properties of probability density functions; Uniform, exponential, and Normal distributions.
